name: React
description: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Mature, widely adopted, with excellent ecosystem and tooling.

name: TypeScript
description: Strongly typed programming language that builds on JavaScript. Essential for large-scale applications.

name: Docker
description: Platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers. Industry standard for containerization.

name: Kubernetes
description: Container orchestration platform. Essential for managing containerized applications at scale.

name: Python
description: Versatile programming language. Great for data science, automation, and web development. Worth exploring for specific use cases.

name: Continuous Integration
description: Practice of automating integration of code changes. Fundamental DevOps practice.

name: Infrastructure as Code
description: Managing infrastructure through machine-readable definition files. Essential for modern cloud operations.

name: GitHub Actions
description: CI/CD platform integrated with GitHub. Excellent for automation and workflow management.

name: Terraform
description: Infrastructure as Code tool. Industry standard for multi-cloud infrastructure management.

name: PostgreSQL
description: Advanced open-source relational database. Reliable, feature-rich, and battle-tested.

name: Next.js
description: React framework with server-side rendering and static site generation. Growing ecosystem, worth pursuing for new projects.

name: Rust
description: Systems programming language focused on safety and performance. Excellent for performance-critical applications.

name: Go (Golang)
description: Fast, statically typed language designed for simplicity and efficiency. Excellent for microservices, CLI tools, and cloud-native applications.

name: GraphQL
description: Query language for APIs. Provides flexibility in data fetching. Consider for API-heavy applications.

name: Micro Frontends
description: Architectural style for splitting frontend into smaller, manageable pieces. Useful for large teams.

name: Deno
description: Modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript. Interesting alternative to Node.js, worth monitoring.

name: WebAssembly
description: Binary instruction format for web browsers. Promising for performance-intensive web applications.

name: Service Mesh
description: Infrastructure layer for handling service-to-service communication. Evaluate for complex microservices architectures.

name: Svelte
description: Frontend framework that compiles to vanilla JavaScript. Interesting approach, worth exploring.

name: Edge Computing
description: Processing data closer to where it's generated. Assess for latency-sensitive applications.

name: Chaos Engineering
description: Practice of testing system resilience by introducing failures. Valuable for distributed systems.

name: MongoDB
description: Document-oriented database. Proceed with caution - consider use case carefully. Better alternatives exist for many scenarios.

name: Microservices by Default
description: Starting with microservices architecture for all projects. Hold - start with monolith unless you have specific needs.

name: jQuery
description: JavaScript library for DOM manipulation. Hold - modern frameworks provide better solutions.

name: Selenium WebDriver
description: Browser automation tool. Hold - newer tools like Playwright offer better developer experience.

name: AWS
description: Cloud computing platform. Industry leader with comprehensive service offerings.

name: Playwright
description: Modern end-to-end testing framework. Excellent cross-browser support and developer experience.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: Utility-first CSS framework. Rapid UI development with consistent design system.

name: Feature Flags
description: Technique for enabling/disabling features at runtime. Essential for continuous deployment.

name: Design Systems
description: Collection of reusable components and guidelines. Critical for consistent UX across products.

name: API-First Design
description: Designing APIs before implementation. Promotes better integration and parallel development.

name: Astro
description: Modern static site builder. Interesting for content-heavy sites, worth exploring.
